page.notes: The title at the top is cut off, so its end is missing. Entries "actio & passio di" / "stinguuntur" and "aerem esse in omnibus mix" / "tis" are split across lines without a hyphen. The Greek word "ἀκουσίας" is doubtful. The faint marks at the bottom left are not legible text and are left out. Long s was read as s; "quid sit" may be "quid fit" and "esse" may be "esse" with a doubtful long s. The first letters of the head line are cut at the left edge; "[?]ime" is the best reading. The Greek lines are read with doubt: "αὐτίχθον" and the sign before "ἀφάνισις". Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
